references.text: Foreigners devour the land, illustrating a reversal of the relationship between Israelites and foreigners, similar to the threat in Deuteronomy.
The contrast to this verse: The Lord will make you the head and not the tail; you shall only go up and never down—if they keep the commandments.
The following verse elaborates on the curse: the foreigner will lend to you, and you will become the tail, not the head.
Proverbs warns against losing one's position to others, reflecting the theme of social degradation.
The Lord will break their proud power—a parallel warning of humiliation as a consequence of disobedience.
